hero.heading: Cookie Policy
hero.description: Learn how Revotek Elevators uses cookies to improve your browsing experience, enhance website performance, and provide secure, reliable services.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, improve functionality, and enhance your browsing experience.
These cookies do not typically contain personally identifiable information but may be linked to information you voluntarily provide while using our website.

sections.title: Why We Use Cookies
content: Revotek Elevators uses cookies to provide a better user experience, improve website functionality, and understand how visitors interact with our website.
Cookies also help us maintain website security, remember your preferences, and optimize overall website performance.

items.title: Essential Cookies
items.description: Required for the website to function properly, including navigation, security, and accessibility features.

items.title: Performance & Analytics Cookies
items.description: Help us understand visitor behavior, website traffic, and overall performance so we can continuously improve our website.

items.title: Functional Cookies
items.description: Remember your preferences, such as language settings or previously entered information, to provide a personalized experience.

items.title: Marketing Cookies
items.description: Currently, Revotek Elevators does not use marketing or advertising cookies. This policy will be updated if such cookies are introduced in the future.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
content: Some features on our website may rely on trusted third-party services such as maps, analytics, embedded videos, or other tools. These providers may place their own cookies on your device.
We recommend reviewing their respective privacy and cookie policies for more information.

sections.title: Managing Cookies
content: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.
Most browsers allow you to view stored cookies, remove existing cookies, block future cookies, or receive notifications before cookies are stored.
Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect some website features and functionality.

sections.title: Your Consent
content: When you first visit our website, you will be asked to accept or reject optional cookies through our cookie consent banner.
Your choice will be saved and can be updated by clearing your browser cookies or changing your browser settings.

sections.title: Changes to This Cookie Policy
content: Revotek Elevators may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements, technology, or our business practices.
Any updates will be published on this page along with the revised 'Last Updated' date.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy or how we use cookies, please contact us.
